description:
Prime 4.5-Hectare Beachfront Property – El Nido, Palawan
A rare investment opportunity in the world-renowned destination of El Nido, Palawan. This 4.5-hectare
titled beachfront property features approximately 171.99 meters of pristine beachfront frontage,
crystal-clear waters, and a naturally sheltered cove.
Located just 20 minutes from El Nido town proper by boat and 5 minutes by speedboat, the property
offers the perfect combination of accessibility, privacy, and exclusivity.
Ideal for a luxury resort, boutique hotel, private villas, or eco-tourism development, this exceptional
property presents outstanding investment potential in one of the Philippines' premier island
destinations.
Property Highlights:
• Titled beachfront property with secure ownership
• Approximately 171.99 meters of prime beachfront frontage
• Stunning white-sand shoreline and crystal-clear turquoise waters
• Located within the world-renowned island paradise of El Nido, Palawan
• Ideal for luxury resorts, boutique hotels, private villas, eco-tourism projects, and high-end
residential developments
• Surrounded by breathtaking natural beauty and spectacular island views
• Excellent accessibility while maintaining privacy and exclusivity
• Exceptional investment opportunity in one of the Philippines' premier tourism destinations
• Strong potential for tourism, hospitality, and long-term property value appreciation
